public_rationale: No decisive event settles the conjunction. OpenAI describes an allowance reduction for eligible existing subscribers after the freeze while keeping their subscription price unchanged. Anthropic announced higher limits, while regional App Store prices moved in both directions. These records do not establish that both providers raised comparable subscription prices and made existing workflows impossible. With no deadline, the forecast remains open.
limitations: The OpenAI help page is mutable; its displayed update age places the accessed version on October 27.
Regional price reporting is secondary evidence because the underlying subscriber notice was not obtained.
Effective usage prices and subscription bills may move differently.

criteria.support_condition: Implemented changes at both providers raise the price of comparable subscription service and impose limits that demonstrably prevent representative workflows previously feasible under those subscriptions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive event establishes that the predicted conjunction cannot occur. Unchanged prices or improved limits during a finite period do not disprove an undated forecast.
